newsitem.title: ALGERIA: Algeria reappoints Ahmed Ouyahia Prime Minister.
newsitem.headline: Algeria reappoints Ahmed Ouyahia Prime Minister.

text.p: Algeria's President Liamine Zeroual on Saturday decided to keep in office former Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia, who had resigned last week following parliamentary elections, a presidency statement said.
The statement carried by the official news agency APS said Zeroual asked Ouyahia "to undertake the necessary consultations to form a new government".
APS also reported that four Algerian officials, including State Minister Mokdad Sifi on Saturday "presented their resignations to President Zeroual who accepted them."
The resignation took place "after the legislative elections of June 5, and in conformity with Algeria's constitution," APS said.
The three other senior officials were Amar Zegrar, secretrary general of the presidency and government advisers Youcef Yousfi and Abdelkader Taffar, APS added.

Last week, Algeria's Constitutional Council endorsed the North African country's general election outcome confirming President Liamine Zeroual's supporters through the National Democratic Rally (RND), which took 155 seats in 380-seat Assembly.
